descriptor: Product analytics dashboard for growing teams

voice.summary: Reads like a good analyst's margin note: short, specific and unbothered by noise. It states what changed, by how much and over what window, and leaves the interpretation to the reader.
dos: State the delta and the period together, for example up 12% in 30 days
Use tabular figures and consistent units
Label every chart with what is being counted
donts: Do not celebrate vanity numbers with exclamation marks
Do not hide a drop behind soft wording
Do not use growth hacker slang

taglines: See the signal, skip the noise
Your traffic, read at a glance
boilerplate: Pulse is a product analytics platform that turns visitor, acquisition and page data into clear dashboards so product teams can see what changed and decide what to do next.
